title: BAI Confident of Smooth World Championships After India Open Fiasco
indian_angle: The Badminton World Championships are set to return to India after 17 years, with BAI assuring no repeat of past issues like monkey sightings or bird droppings from the India Open fiasco.
summary: The showpiece event returns to India after 17 years at New Delhi’s Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium from August 17-23. BAI is confident of avoiding issues seen in previous tournaments.

title: PV Sindhu Launches Multi-Sport Centre for Sports Excellence in Visakhapatnam
indian_angle: Indian badminton icon P.V. Sindhu has inaugurated a significant multi-sport facility in Visakhapatnam, initially focused on badminton but expanding to seven disciplines.
summary: What began as an initiative focused solely on badminton expanded into a multi-sport project following discussions with Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu and will now cater to seven disciplines — badminton, table tennis, swimming, shooting, football, basketball and chess.

title: Sindhu 9th Seed, Satwik-Chirag 5th for BWF World Championships
indian_angle: India's top badminton stars, PV Sindhu and the men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, have received key seedings for the upcoming BWF World Championships.
summary: PV Sindhu was seeded ninth in the women's singles for the upcoming BWF World Championships on Tuesday. Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty secured the fifth seed in men's doubles.

title: New Scoring System Will Benefit Some Players, Challenge Others: Gopichand
indian_angle: Indian national coach Pullela Gopichand offers his expert perspective on the implications of badminton's new scoring system for Indian players.
summary: National coach Pullela Gopichand commented on badminton's new scoring system, anticipating it will significantly impact players, benefiting some while challenging others.
